edits.new: The plant grows bushy and fills out to its full size, usually about three feet tall and standing on its own without support. Edamame makes much of its own food (nitrogen) at this stage, so you want healthy green growth, not huge dark leafy plants, which usually mean too much fertilizer and fewer pods.

edits.new: Steady, bushy growth as the plant fills out to its full height of about three feet, sturdy and upright with no need for support, building the canopy that will carry the pods. The plant is fixing much of its own nitrogen now through root nodules, so vigorous green growth, not dark, overfed lushness, is the goal.
